itens.trecho: Temos aqui a estética típica de Del Toro, tal como vimos em seu filme anterior, O beco do pesadelo (2021). Mas sua versão do Pinóquio é uma animação em stop-motion, na qual bonecos e cenários são construídos para o filme. O resultado, esteticamente, é belíssimo. Esta é uma animação que precisa ser vista no idioma original.

I didn’t even know that Guillermo del Toro had made an adaptation of Pinocchio until my daughter and oldest son told me they wanted to watch it during our traditional movie evening yesterday. Wow, that was a different take on Pinocchio indeed. Pinocchio, the original, is not surprisingly, one of the movies I watched as a kid and which is quite dear to me.
Set against the rise of Mussolini, this adaptation of the Collodi story draws parallels with the adventures of the eponymous puppet and the fascist's coming to power in Italy.
